briefing.title: Training Range: Making a Stand
story: The second exercise has rocks to hide behind and a drone that does not wait politely. Expand your economy, then meet its waves with units of your own design.
Good commanders are ready before the first wave arrives.
objectives: Destroy every enemy unit and building
tips: Rock outcrops block movement and make good choke points.
Try the Designer from the main menu to build a unit that suits the map.
